convert_jats_xml_to_docling: convert a JATS XML document into a DoclingDocument structure for downstream processing
parse_jats_metadata: parse JATS XML metadata including title, authors, and abstract sections from an article
add_jats_headings: add hierarchical headings and sections from JATS XML body content into a DoclingDocument
parse_jats_citations: parse JATS element-citation and mixed-citation nodes into formatted citation strings
add_jats_tables: parse JATS table-wrap elements and convert them into DoclingDocument table structures
